items.title: Trading at the Speed of… Chat? with Chloe Casale
items.author: Jane Street
items.content:
Chloe Casale was planning to be an auto mechanic before taking an intro CS class on a bet. After a stint as a Forward Deployed Engineer at Palantir, Chloe came to Jane Street with no background in OCaml or finance. Now she leads a team of “desk devs” building tools for client-facing traders. In this episode, Ron and Chloe discuss how a surprising amount of Jane Street’s client business is conducted via chat, and the promise and perils of using LLMs to automate that trading. They dive deep on hiring and interviewing: does Jane Street’s process select for less “spiky” kinds of people than Palantir’s? Along the way, they marvel at Webs, an internal spreadsheet-like framework for composing computations and building UIs (which, you can see, is sort of hard to explain); compare building software for internal versus external customers; and recount the tale of Chloe’s epic 1,000km horse race across the Mongolian steppe.

You can find the transcript for this episode on our website.
